chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
When the deceased dies, what is owed to him and what he owes become due.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.مَا عَلَيْهِ: what he owes or is due from him
key_terms.مَا لَهُ: what is owed to him or belongs to him as a claim

ai.seo_question: What happens to a person's debts and financial claims when he dies in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle concerning financial obligations at the time of death. When a person dies, both debts owed by him and claims owed to him become immediately due and subject to settlement.
